bio.text: Tom Sell, a Lubbock businessman, won the Republican primary runoff on May 26, 2026 for Texas's 19th Congressional District, the seat of retiring Rep. Jodey Arrington.
He describes himself as a fifth-generation West Texan whose family came to Lubbock in 1906, and says that he raised four children there.
He previously worked for former U.S. Rep. Larry Combest and served as deputy staff director for the House Agriculture Committee from 1999 to early 2003, according to The Texas Tribune.

sources.title: West Texas congressional candidates split on campaign strategy: Defend farmers or Trump?
Tom Sell wins District 19 Republican primary runoff
